Hi! I have never been here before. What is DeskAtlas and how does it work?

DeskAtlas

With DeskAtlas, you can book a physical desk or room online or walk in to use the on-site kiosk. You do not need a personal account or prior registration to make a standard guest booking.

To book online, select a workspace on the website, provide your contact details, and submit the request. A pending status does not hold inventory; you must complete payment and upload proof within 60 minutes for an administrator to verify and confirm your assignment.

The shared kiosk is intended for visitors physically present at SKYDY. The customer chooses a specific physical desk/room, permitted schedule or pass, reviews the current quote, provides the requested guest details and chooses Cash or QR Payment. It does not require a personal-account login, and browsing/queue assignment does not hold the space. Customers needing private booking history or rewards should primarily use the verified website flow on their own devices.

question: How do I book and pay? Do I need an account, and when is my desk actually confirmed?
response:
You

How do I book and pay? Do I need an account, and when is my desk actually confirmed?

DeskAtlas

On the public customer website, select a physical named workspace from the map; select a permitted date, start time and duration; confirm capacity, price/pass and session end time (including the next date for overnight use); optionally rank eligible same-type alternatives; enter requested first/last name and a reachable booking email; review the summary and submit. No customer account is required. Keep the queue/reference displayed after submission.

## **Review and confirmation boundary**

A successful submission creates a pending request and queue number; it does not hold a unit. The website issues booking-specific payment instructions and a private payment page after submission; an initial administrator approval is not required before paying. Complete payment and proof upload before the server-recorded 60-minute payment-session deadline. Administrator review occurs after proof submission and does not guarantee allocation. After payment-proof verification, final allocation must

still find a valid non-overlapping unit from approved choices. Only an explicit final confirmation showing the actual physical unit and schedule establishes a confirmed booking. If all choices conflict, staff must follow the authorized recovery/reconciliation path; payment alone must not cause duplicate allocation.

Website reservations have no integrated card-payment gateway. After submitting a website request, follow the payment methods and recipient details shown on its official private payment page. Submit genuine proof for subsequent administrator review; paying does not require an earlier administrator approval. On-site shared kiosk walk-ins instead offer staff-handled cash or the currently displayed authorized static QR transfer, followed by staff verification. Website payment instructions must never be inferred from an old screenshot or kiosk QR.

## **Confirmation email**

The final verified message identifies the actual booked workspace, time window and check-in directions. A bank receipt, payment QR, queue number, admin approval email or proof-upload success message is never independently a confirmed reservation.

question: What if my plans change or I arrive late? Can I cancel, move the booking, or get a refund?
response:
You

What if my plans change or I arrive late? Can I cancel, move the booking, or get a refund?

DeskAtlas

To cancel or reschedule, you must request at least 24 hours before your start time; same-day changes are not accepted under the standard rule. If you arrive late, your booking end time does not shift. For eligible timely cancellations, a 50% refund of the verified payment base is available, subject to approved policy.

To move your booking, you must request an authorized amendment with your reference and reason. Staff will check availability and price differences. You must not occupy a new space until you receive a revised official confirmation.

For emergencies or business-initiated issues, staff will review the specific case. Do not assume automatic waivers or refunds. Retain your booking reference and payment receipt, and contact the front desk or official SKYDY Messenger for verified resolution.
